title: Stock Returns over the FOMC Cycle
summary: One ES RTH adaptation of lagged cycle weeks2/4/6 eligible for preregistered design; no financial outcomes observed.
about: Biweekly equity returns following scheduled FOMC meetings.
findings: Authors report10.9bp/day incremental weeks2/4/6 in1994-2016,17.6bp in2014-16; strongest after declines. Not independently reproduced; working paper2018-02-12 differs from published2019version.
mechanism: Proposed Fed information processing and unexpectedly accommodating policy reduce downside-risk premia; not guaranteed forced orders.
build_on: Owned ES RTH calendar-only adaptation, no week0/private news/future schedule/price-decline feature. Test fixed gross/cost gate and matched-calendar control, then advance only earned stages.
